summary: Plan IPM, pesticide stewardship, residue controls, and traceability for export supply chains. Review the practical five-day course outline.
lede: Integrated pest management and pesticide stewardship for export value chains link crop-pest controls with pesticide, residue, and traceability records. The course is for agribusiness compliance teams, exporter and processor staff, extension programme managers, and supply-chain practitioners who plan and assess controls across farms, aggregation points, and processors. Participants practise assessing pest and residue risks, reviewing pesticide-use and pre-harvest interval records, planning residue sampling, mapping lot traceability, and organizing buyer-audit evidence.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for crop-protection controls, pesticide records, residue assurance, and traceability evidence in export-oriented agricultural supply chains.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: Working familiarity with agricultural sourcing, crop-protection support, processing, export operations, or supplier compliance will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required. Access to spreadsheet software is useful for the dashboard exercise.
